title: Circuit of the all-ones family
statement: For every natural number $n$, the circuit assigned by the all-ones family to inputs of length $n$ is exactly the depth-one circuit with input nodes indexed by $[0m[0mFin\,n$, one output node, and an AND gate taking all $n$ input values.
